title: Build a diffusion vocoder
brief: Build DiffWave's step embedding and gated residual block, align a 6-step fast schedule to the training schedule, write the loss and fast sampler, and compute Grad-TTS's forward statistics; the run trains a small DiffWave on spoken digits.
hints: diffusion_embedding: freqs = 10 ** (4 * arange(h) / (h - 1)); angle = t[:, None] * freqs[None, :]; concatenate sin and cos along dim 1.
In ResidualBlock.forward, diffusion_projection(emb) has shape (B, C); add [:, :, None] so it broadcasts over time.
diffwave_alignment interpolates linearly in sqrt(alpha_bar), not in alpha_bar, between the two training steps that bracket gamma_bar_s.
fast_sample walks the fast schedule backwards: its last entry, the noisiest, is used first.
